response.rationale: The order is still in "processing" status and has not been delivered (days_since_delivery is null), so no delivery-window rule has expired. The item is not final sale, not on fraud hold, and not defective. Since final_sale == False and the standard 30-day window has not lapsed, RET-007 applies and the return is eligible. Note: because the order is still processing, cancellation may be the appropriate mechanism, but under the return-policy rules the item qualifies as returnable.
